changes.text: 吴起替魏国守住西河，连当时的宰相田文都承认功劳不如他。后来的魏相公叔忌恨他，想把他赶走，设了一个两步的局：先劝国君把公主许配给吴起，再请吴起到家里，看自己的公主妻子当面轻慢自己。吴起辞了婚，国君起了疑心，不再信他。

Wu Qi held Wei's western frontier at Xihe, and even Tian Wen, chief minister at the time, admitted that his record was the greater. A later chief minister, Gongshu, resented him and wanted to drive him out, so he laid a two-step trap: persuade the ruler to offer Wu Qi a princess in marriage, then bring Wu Qi home to watch Gongshu's own wife, a princess, treat her husband with contempt. Wu Qi declined the marriage, and the ruler grew suspicious and stopped trusting him.
那场脾气和那门婚事都不是巧合，而是公叔按照自家仆人的计策一手安排的。一位替魏国守住西河、连宰相田文都承认功劳不如他的将军，为什么一门婚事就让他在魏国待不下去？

Neither the temper nor the marriage offer was an accident: both were arranged by Gongshu, following a plan from one of his own servants. How could a single marriage offer drive out a general who had held Wei's western frontier, and whose record even the chief minister Tian Wen admitted was greater than his own?

仗打赢了，鲁国却有人在国君面前指责他，说吴起「猜忍」，意思是为人多疑狠厉。这人翻出他的旧事：年轻时家有千金，出外求官不成，把家产败光，被乡邻嘲笑，他杀了三十多个讥讽他的人，离开卫国；临走咬破胳膊向母亲发誓，不做卿相不回卫国；后来母亲去世，他也没有回去，老师曾子因此和他断绝来往。这人还替鲁君算了一笔账：鲁国是小国，有了打胜仗的名声，各国就会来打鲁国的主意；鲁、卫是兄弟之国，重用吴起，等于抛弃卫国。鲁君起了疑心，辞退了吴起。吴起听说魏国国君魏文侯贤明，便去投奔魏国。

After the victory, someone in Lu denounced him to its ruler, charging that Wu Qi was suspicious and ruthless. The accuser dug up his past: as a young man from a rich family he had sought office abroad and failed, squandering the family fortune; when his neighbours laughed at him, he killed more than thirty of those who mocked him and left Wey. Parting from his mother, he bit his arm and swore never to return to Wey until he was a chief minister. When his mother later died he did not go back, and his teacher Zengzi broke with him. The accuser also did the sums for Lu's ruler: Lu was a small state, and a name for victories would make the other states eye it greedily; Lu and Wey were brother states, so to employ Wu Qi was to abandon Wey. The ruler of Lu grew suspicious and dismissed him. Hearing that Marquis Wen, the ruler of Wei, was a worthy ruler, Wu Qi went to serve him.

魏文侯先问李克，吴起是个什么样的人。李克的评价毁誉参半：「起貪而好色，然用兵司馬穰苴不能過也」，说吴起贪婪又好色，可论带兵，连司马穰苴也超不过他。吴起带兵，和最下等的士兵吃穿一样，睡觉不铺席子，行军不骑马坐车，自己背粮食。有个士兵生了毒疮，吴起亲口替他吸脓。士兵的母亲听说后大哭：当年吴将军也替孩子的父亲吸过疮，他父亲打仗从不回头，死在敌阵里；如今又替她儿子吸，她不知道儿子会死在哪里了。文侯看重吴起会用兵、廉洁公平、深得士兵之心，派他镇守西河，抵御秦国和韩国。

Marquis Wen first asked Li Ke what sort of man Wu Qi was. Li Ke's verdict was mixed: Wu Qi was greedy and fond of women, but in the use of troops not even Sima Rangju could surpass him. As a commander, Wu Qi dressed and ate like the lowest of his soldiers, slept without a mat, marched instead of riding, and carried his own rations. When one soldier had an abscess, Wu Qi sucked out the pus himself. The soldier's mother wept when she heard. Years before, she said, General Wu had done the same for the boy's father, who then fought without ever turning back and died among the enemy; now he had done it for her son, and she did not know where her son would die. Valuing Wu Qi's skill with troops, his honesty and fairness, and the loyalty he won from his men, Marquis Wen made him governor of Xihe, to hold off Qin and Han.
后来魏国任命宰相，用了田文。吴起很不高兴，去找田文比功劳。他一连比了三件事，其中两件是：统领三军，让士兵乐意为国拼命，敌国不敢打魏国的主意，你比我怎样？田文说：「不如子」，不如你。镇守西河，让秦兵不敢向东进犯，韩、赵两国都来归附，你比我怎样？田文还是说不如你。三件比完，吴起问：这三件你都在我之下，职位却在我之上，这是为什么？

Later, when Wei appointed a chief minister, it chose Tian Wen. Wu Qi was displeased and challenged Tian Wen to compare their merits. He compared them on three counts; two of them were these. In command of the armies, making soldiers glad to die and enemy states afraid to plot against Wei, how do you compare with me? Tian Wen said: Not as well as you. Holding Xihe, so that Qin's troops dare not march east and Han and Zhao come as guests, how do you compare with me? Again Tian Wen said he could not match him. When the three were done, Wu Qi asked: in all three you rank below me, yet your post ranks above mine. Why?
田文死后，公叔做了宰相。公叔娶的是魏国公主，他忌恨吴起，想把他赶走。公叔的仆人说：吴起很容易赶走。公叔问怎么办，仆人先说吴起的为人：「吳起為人節廉而自喜名也」，有节操、清廉，又看重自己的名声。接着献上一个两步的计策。

After Tian Wen died, Gongshu became chief minister. Gongshu was married to a princess of Wei, and he resented Wu Qi and wanted to drive him out. His servant said: Wu Qi is easy to drive away. When Gongshu asked how, the servant first described the man: Wu Qi had integrity, kept his hands clean, and prized his good name. Then he laid out a plan in two steps.

第一步，公叔先去对当时的魏国国君武侯说：吴起是个贤人，可是您的国家小，又和强大的秦国接壤，我私下担心吴起没有长久留下的心。照仆人的设计，武侯会问：那怎么办？公叔就建议「試延以公主」，拿把公主许配给吴起来试探他：有心留下，一定会接受；无心留下，一定会推辞，「以此卜之」，就用这件事来占卜他的去留。第二步，公叔请吴起到家里，让自己的妻子，也就是那位公主，当着吴起的面发怒、轻慢公叔。仆人断定，吴起看到公主这样轻贱自己的丈夫，一定会推辞这门婚事。

Step one: Gongshu would tell Marquis Wu, then ruler of Wei, that Wu Qi was a man of worth, but that the marquis's state was small and bordered on mighty Qin, and he privately feared Wu Qi had no mind to stay. In the servant's script, the marquis would ask what to do. Gongshu would then propose testing Wu Qi with the offer of a princess: if he meant to stay he would surely accept, and if not he would surely decline, so the offer would serve as a divination of his intentions. Step two: Gongshu would invite Wu Qi home and have his own wife, the princess, flare up and slight her husband in front of him. Seeing a princess treat her husband with such contempt, the servant predicted, Wu Qi would surely turn the marriage down.
在楚国，楚悼王早就听说他贤能，让他做了宰相。他严明法令，裁掉不急需的官员，罢免与王室血缘疏远的公族，集中力量强兵，楚国强盛起来，各国都忧虑楚国的强大。史书写道，因此楚国的贵戚都想害他。悼王一死，王族大臣作乱，攻击吴起；吴起跑到悼王遗体处，伏在遗体上，攻击他的人又射又刺吴起，也击中了悼王的遗体。太子即位后，下令把射中王尸的人全部处死，因此被灭族的有七十多家。

In Chu, King Dao, who had long heard of his ability, made him chief minister. He made the laws clear and strict, cut offices that were not needed, removed royal kinsmen of distant blood from their privileges, and put the state's strength into its army; Chu grew strong, and the other states feared its power. For this reason, the history says, Chu's nobles all wanted him dead. When King Dao died, members of the royal clan rose up and attacked Wu Qi. He ran to the king's body and threw himself on it; his attackers shot and stabbed him, and struck the king's body too. Once the crown prince came to the throne, he had everyone who had struck the king's body put to death, and more than seventy families were wiped out for it.
一家小公司里，一位功劳清楚的核心成员被安排了一次试探：管理层假装公司要与另一家合并，想看他是立刻站队还是观望。他看出这是试探后当场请辞，管理层反而认定他本来就没打算留下。

In a small company, a core member with an unmistakable record is handed a staged test: management pretends the firm is about to merge with another, to see whether he immediately picks a side or watches and waits. He sees through the arrangement and resigns on the spot — and management reads the resignation as proof that he never meant to stay.

dispositions.rationale: 删去“功劳无人能比 / no one in Wei could match his record”。中英文都改为只说宰相田文承认功劳不如他，这一点有证据支持。
中文“想除掉他”改为“忌恨他，想把他赶走”。英文同步改为 resented him and wanted to drive him out。
英文改为 grew suspicious and stopped trusting him。中文同步改为“国君起了疑心，不再信他”，与“疑之而弗信”对应。
中文改为“连宰相田文都承认功劳不如他”，英文同步修改，删去“谁也比不上”的说法。
删去“第一句就是 / The first charge was”，改为直接转述进言者说吴起「猜忍」。
中文写明“魏国国君魏文侯”。英文同步改为 Marquis Wen, the ruler of Wei，两版一致。

evidence.quote: 吳起於是聞魏文侯賢，欲事之。

dispositions.rationale: 删去李克的职务“大臣 / his minister”。
“设立宰相”改为“任命宰相”。英文改为 when Wei appointed a chief minister, it chose Tian Wen。
先交代吴起一连比了三件事，正文列出其中两件，后文“三件比完”因此读得通。英文同步修改。
“想把他除掉”改为“想把他赶走”。英文同步改为 wanted to drive him out。

evidence.quote: 而害吳起。公叔之僕曰：「起易去也。」

dispositions.rationale: 在故事部分首次提到武侯处写明“当时的魏国国君武侯 / Marquis Wu, then ruler of Wei”，没有补写他与文侯的亲属关系或继位时间。
把转折“却 / But”改为史书原有的因果，并标明是史书的说法：“史书写道，因此…… / For this reason, the history says”。

evidence.quote: 故楚之貴戚盡欲害吳起。

dispositions.rationale: 三处都已改正：“围攻”改为“攻击”；“伏下”改为“伏在遗体上”，与英文一致；“射中”改为“又射又刺”，英文改为 shot and stabbed him。“并中”写作“击中 / struck”，没有添加致死的细节。

evidence.quote: 吳起走之王尸而伏之。擊起之徒因射刺吳起，并中悼王。

dispositions.rationale: 删去现代场景中带引号的原词“无留心”，改为“认定他本来就没打算留下”，与英文 proof that he never meant to stay 一致。英文原文无需改动，按同步规则照录。
